Grimes died at the age of about 52 and was buried on 15 October 1657. Grimes married Alice Lovell, daughter of Charles Lovell, of West Harling, Norfolk. George Grimes (English politician) Sir George Grimes (1605–1657) was an English politician who sat in the House of Commons from 1628 to 1629. He supported the Royalist cause in the English Civil War. Grimes was the son of Sir Thomas Grimes and his wife Margaret More, daughter of Sir George More
